Tweaks.RecipeListCompletionMarks.Name: Recipe List completion marks
Tweaks.RecipeListCompletionMarks.Descrip: Shows the Crafting Log check mark next to every recipe in the "Recipes List" window that you have already crafted.
Tweaks.RecipeListCompletionMarks.AnyClas: If an item can be crafted by several classes, mark it when you crafted it with any of them, not only with the class of its section.
